tw-wi-new-london-hoffman-orchard.st: Already on 28 March 1908, besieged by begging letters, Hoffman told the Green Bay paper the buried fortune was 'a myth': the garden find was 'a very ordinary' sum that 'would just about take me to Frisco and back'.
src: Green Bay Press-Gazette, 28 Mar 1908, p. 1, 'Admits That Buried Fortune Was a Myth'
